title: Access Rehearsal Lab: Workspace Role Simulation & Cost Impact Preview
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem statement: Admins and security engineers need a safe, explainable way to preview the downstream effects of changing workspace roles and permissions without impacting production. Current Console flows show static role membership and separate audit logs, but do not let admins simulate changes across multiple resources, preview resulting access paths, or estimate cost/SLO impact (e.g., who can spin up models on Dedicated capacity, which routes increase token costs).

Goal: Ship an interactive 'Access Rehearsal Lab' in Console that lets operators: 1) run 'what-if' simulations for role edits and role assignments across workspaces; 2) visualize a permission diff and the access paths created/removed; 3) preview estimated cost changes and affected models/routes; 4) surface audit traces and a replayable session example for impacted tokens. Deliver a high-fidelity prototype and usability findings to inform engineering scope for console-2025.03.

Scope: Design the main entrypoint (Rehearsal Home), simulator canvas (role diff viewer + resource map), a cost delta estimator panel (token/cost SLO projection), and an audit replay surface that links to existing audit logs. Exclude backend implementation details (KV exports/auditing infra) — design should map to available APIs but tolerate incremental backend features.

Trade-offs discussed: 
- Accuracy vs speed: cost estimator will be a heuristic for initial launch (based on last-30-day usage and route-permission mappings) to avoid heavy precomputation. Engineering will mark estimator as 'approximate' until a more accurate estimator is available.
- Surface complexity vs discoverability: default view should be compact with an "expand to detailed diff" option to avoid overwhelming admins.
- Privacy: simulated runs must not expose unrelated user PII. Prototype uses synthetic session replays.

Success metrics: 
- Task completion in usability test: create a new role, simulate assignment, and identify at least 2 unintended access paths (goal 85% completion).
- Reduce support tickets about "unexpected access" by 30% in Q2 after release.
- +10% of canary rollouts include a pre-release rehearsal run documented in Console flows.
acceptance_criteria: Rehearsal Home tile is discoverable from Workspace Settings and Admin Dashboard
Simulator allows choosing an existing role or creating a temporary role draft
Permission diff highlights additions/removals grouped by resource type (Models, Routes, Billing, Secrets)
Cost Delta panel shows estimated token and dollar delta and flags high-risk routes
Audit Replay links to the concrete audit log entries and shows a synthetic example session replay
Prototype validated with 6+ engineers/ops participants and prioritized usability bugs logged
comments: 2025-02-14 AP: Kickoff — aligned with PM to focus on RBAC & Billing intersections. Decided to prototype an estimator rather than block on backend telemetry.
2025-02-18 ML: Wireframes v0 uploaded to Figma. Key pattern: compact summary + expandable detailed diff. Asked ENG to confirm available APIs for membership/existing traces.
2025-02-20 EK (Eng): ENG-22019 will expose role->route mappings and last-30-day route usage. Estimator will initially exclude embeddings-heavy batch jobs (edge case).
2025-02-24 AP: Usability study recruitment — target 8 admins across 4 customers; test script drafted (link in attachments).

2025-02-26 ML: Design critique with Security and Product. Feedback: show 'least-privilege impact' badge and require two-step confirmation for apply. Added warnings for elevated permissions that enable Dedicated capacity launch.
2025-03-01 AP: Prototype passed internal review. Logged 7 UX issues (DES-912346..DES-912352) for follow-up. Ready to handoff to ENG with PRD and Figma.
2025-03-01 ML: Noted blocker — audit replay requires a lightweight session obfuscation pipeline; flagged security review.
risk_mitigation: Estimator labeled clearly as 'approximate' and will include links to raw telemetry. Sensitive audit replay content will be obfuscated and only shown to users with 'audit_view' permission. For the first release, 'apply role changes' button is disabled in the Rehearsal Lab — only exports to a draft change request that goes through normal approval flow.
next_steps: Handoff packet: attach high-fidelity prototype, PRD, and ACE (API contract) to ENG
Schedule 2-week engineering spike (ENG-22019) to implement estimator and role mapping APIs
Run moderated usability sessions (target week of 2025-03-10) and incorporate top 5 fixes
Plan canary coordinates and telemetry (console-2025.03) with SRE
